Episode 259. The Truth of the World, Your Truth, My Truth (11)
A streak of darkness flowed down from the sky. The darkness that touched the ground soon took the form of a person and became the Witch Helluram.
As if her encounter with Kelliark had all been a lie, she was in perfect condition. It wasn't just her appearance; everyone could feel the dark and infinite abyss stirring in the entire sky.
[Hey, hey... Helluram! It's not you, right?]
The first to speak upon seeing her was Orgal.
[What do you mean, it's not? Orgal.]

[You're not, by any chance, going to say you're going to eliminate the light and fight us now, are you? No, by the way, why are you so unharmed? Weren't you about to die just a little while ago? No, I think you might have been completely dead.]
[It seems you find my well-being very distasteful.]
Orgal was about to argue but flinched and examined Helluram again.
[Wait... you're not the... Helluram I knew, are you? You're similar, but something is definitely different... Who are you?]
[Nature has many forms. It can be a calamity, or it can be a blessing.]
[What...?]
[That is all. The form of me you knew was broken. Just as Solderet was... now it is time for me, too, to return as he did.]
Light and darkness are one.

And Solderet and Helluram were beings derived from them. A being in whom the desire of nature was substantiated. She now realized that she no longer had a place in the world. That since the desire that was Solderet had disappeared, she too ought to become so.
The infinite beings had to return to nature. The world was a stage prepared for the finite. Order was just order; it could not be a member of the stage.

[To be honest, I don't remember well why the nature that is Solderet and I, or a part of it, came into the world through Kinzelo. All I remember clearly is that we were divided because Solderet chose people over me. However, now I think I can understand him.]

The Helluram who had wanted to erase the light from the world to take revenge on Solderet had been annihilated by Kelliark's hand. The Helluram who now met Jin's eyes was another side of the darkness.

[You all have, in the end, moved the darkness. You have done what the light that is Solderet could not do. Or it could be said that you have atoned for the sins he committed against me... Now I feel like being a blessing, not a calamity. Therefore, for you all, I will gladly offer this body.]
[H-Helluram, are you serious...!?]

[Is it so surprising, Orgal? Even I, who wanted to be the calamity that eliminates the light, had made countless of you into soldiers of the abyss. Perhaps I had already been moved by you all from that time.]
[For real...!?]
[Yes.]
[For real, for real!? You're not going to suddenly backstab us after this, are you?]
[I'm suddenly feeling like quitting...]
At those words, Jin reflexively grabbed Orgal's head and made him bow.
"Apologize quickly, Orgal."
[Uh, huh? Uh, right! I'm sorry, Helluram! Th-it felt so much like a dream, I think I went crazy for a moment. Wow, it really feels like a dream...]
It felt like a dream.

Everyone felt that way. If the world could truly be restored and those who had been brutally trampled and killed by Kelliark could come back, then Helluram's sudden change of heart wasn't even that strange. As she said, nature just has many forms.
The world is coming back.
It was something they couldn't believe until they saw it with their own two eyes. It was so even though everyone already knew the power of the Origin Stone and the Sun God Kinzelo.
However, Jin remembered what Elona had just said. She had clearly said that the sacrifice of 'a few', including herself, was needed.
[Sun God... no, Elona Zipple. Call forth Bligiet, Nepdol, Beltian, and Focal. From now on, in the world you will live in, there will be no dangerous gods.]
From Laprarosa, which had flown near Jin, everyone, including them, was coming down to the ground.
The egos of the Sun God had already foreseen their annihilation while flying over. Elona's will had been transmitted to them from the moment she had first awakened.
"Jin!"
[Young Patriarch...!]
It was Valeria and Luet. The egos of the Sun God stood behind the people and looked at Elona. Beltian was also seen to have escaped from the restraint of the power source.
[We have time to say goodbye to our friends for a moment, right?]
As Elona nodded, Bligiet, Nepdol, and Focal each hugged the people standing next to them once.
[I am sorry that I had forgotten how much I loved you all when I was whole.]
[I think Elona is showing that heart on our behalf... kkyu. We didn't have much time to get close while fighting, but still, I'll miss you all.]
[Now the world will regain its beautiful form. No, it would be more correct to say that it can become beautiful for the first time.]
[Beltian, you say your goodbyes too. We won't be able to see our creations again.]
At Bligiet's words, Beltian shook his head with a very gloomy face.
[Do you have to show that you're an ego of destruction until the very end? Malugia has also decided to follow Kinzelo's... no, Elona's will now.]
[Yes, Beltian, don't be like that, let's hug. Kkyu.]
[I was sorry... Live, well, everyone. Now I... won't be able to carry you all on that flying fortress and take you anywhere.]
Now, the egos of destruction, reconstruction, and maintenance were gone. The will of the whole Sun God, Elona Zipple, was embracing them as one.
That was why the egos that had pursued ruin felt greater pain. Just as Elona was regretting her past.
[But even without me, everyone, fly freely anywhere... live as if you can really fly anywhere. You were created by us, but you are better and more shining beings than us, so you can do that, right?]
The egos of the Sun God were slowly blurring and seeping into Elona. The giant sun energy remaining behind was also flowing towards Elona.
The more it did, the more she lost her human form. A galaxy formed in her wet eyes, and her whole body shone brightly with a golden light.
That was why Veradin embraced her even more strongly. He came out of her embrace and hugged her with his whole body.
[Lord Jin.]
"Speak, Lady Elona."
[Lastly, there are more beings needed...]
Squeeze. Jin closed his eyes for a moment.
"Light... do you mean the beings created from Solderet..."
Elona nodded heavily.
Light and darkness, light and shadow.
The final element absolutely necessary for the restoration of the world was a nature that could only exist when the other was present.
[Misha, come forth.]
At Helluram's voice, the center of the dark sky opened. A scene followed where Misha descended to the ground from within.

Misha had originally been looking for a chance to step in herself. But the more Kelliark's power destroyed the world, the more she couldn't move at all, busy controlling the order of shadow so that Jin wouldn't lose his shadow energy.

Then, when Jin had reached the legacy, Misha had faced the truth Solderet had left behind together with him. From what this world had originated, what she herself was. Because to be Solderet's proxy meant to become Solderet himself.
[Ah, geez... to see that face at a good moment like this, again. Ugh, I hate it, I hate it.]
[Well done, Murakan. Jin did it thanks to you getting a grip at the end.]
[Why are you being so creepy? It's giving me the creeps, so just act as you usually do. As you usually do.]
[You really only talk like a person when you're hit...]
Jin couldn't open his mouth as he looked at his nonchalant guardian dragons.
Elona couldn't look at Jin, as if she were a sinner, then steeled herself and looked into his blank eyes.
[I'm sorry, Lord Jin.]
[No, what are you sorry for? If it weren't for you, the world would have ended like this. Don't give the kid unnecessary guilt. Huh?]

"No... wait a minute. Lady Elona, Helluram. Not Murakan and Lady Misha. I will sacrifice myself. I have the most shadow energy anyway, don't I? It was only a little, but I was the only one who handled the light directly."
[You can't.]
"Why, why can't I?"

[Because you are not fundamentally a nature like me or Solderet. But these children are nature. And it's not just these children who are sacrificing. All the immortals sealed in the Origin Stone. Nature like fire, water, and wind are all returning as well.]
"Still, this is..."
This is wrong.
He couldn't bring himself to say those words out loud. For Murakan and Misha, Jin could sacrifice his life several times over, but he couldn't give up on the world's restoration to save them.
Because he hadn't fought alone.
It wasn't a victory won by fighting alone. The number of people who had fought together to protect the world was countless.
[Kid.]
Jin grabbed the smiling Murakan's face with both hands.
"Murakan, hey... I'll do it instead. Ah."

[She said you can't, so why do you keep doing that, you brat? And we're guardian dragons, for crying out loud. How can we sacrifice you instead of us? Misha and I are over three thousand years old. We've lived long enough. In contrast, you're a brat who isn't even thirty yet. There's no fledgling like this fledgling. Of course you should live.]
"You, what about the strawberry pies, what about Gilly?"
Murakan couldn't answer for a long while.
[...Then you, punk. If you die, what about the people who love you? And she said it's impossible for you!]
Jin couldn't answer either.

[Aww, my head hurts. Kid, to Strawberry Pie... dammit, to Strawberry Pie... sob... sniff, damn. Tell her that I loved her more than anyone... no, that's too cruel. Just lie and say I was just playing around. Aish, this is also a bit... she wouldn't believe it either. What should I do? Hah. Right, let's just say I loved her. That seems right. What exactly to tell her is... hmm, Strawberry Pie... Strawberry Pie, sob...]
Murakan buried his head in Jin's shoulder, his face a mess of tears and snot. He couldn't think of what to say to Strawberry Pie at all.
And Misha, who saw that, made a disgusted face and said this.
[You're really making a scene. Anyone would think we're saying goodbye to the world forever, you stupid brat. It's so cringey, really.]
Murakan, sniffling, raised his head. For the first time in his life, he looked at his demon-like sister with sparkling eyes.
[Wh-what does that mean? Is... is it not a final farewell? Misha? Can I meet the kid and Strawberry Pie again?]
